title: Score an intent, a translation, and a dialogue state
brief: Compute intent accuracy and micro slot F1, pick an intent from an n-best list, score a sentence with BLEU and chrF, and merge a dialogue state across two turns.
hints: intent_accuracy is the number of equal intent strings divided by the length of gold.
slot_f1 turns each dict into a set of (name, value) pairs. Pool true positives, false positives, and false negatives across utterances before you divide. When every count is zero, return 1.
nbest_intent adds math.exp(log_p) inside each intent. The first hypothesis is not the answer on the planted list.
bleu splits on whitespace. For order 2, add 1 to the clipped hits and to the hypothesis count. Multiply by exp(1 - r/c) when the hypothesis is shorter than the reference.
chrf drops spaces, clips character unigram counts by the reference, and returns 2PR/(P+R).
update_dialogue_state copies state['slots'] and then updates that copy. Store system_act. Do not replace the slot dict with only this turn.
